raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "work at"
      role subject ?x
      role location "Iasi"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have unused annual leave"
      role subject ?x
      role object ?days
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?days above 5
